verse.text: For the Lord is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.

reflection.scripture: For the Lord is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.
reflection.observation: This verse is the closing declaration of Psalm 100 — a psalm of thanksgiving. It doesn't just say God was good or will be good. It states it as a present, enduring reality. His love isn't seasonal, and His faithfulness isn't limited to our lifetime — it stretches across all generations. That means the same God who was faithful to your grandparents is faithful to you today, and will be faithful to those who come after you.
reflection.application: When life feels uncertain or your circumstances shift, anchor yourself in what doesn't change. God's character is constant. Write down one area where you've seen His faithfulness recently — even if it's small. Let that memory become a foothold of trust for whatever you're walking through now.
reflection.prayer: Lord, thank You that Your goodness isn't dependent on my feelings and Your love doesn't have an expiration date. Help me to see Your faithfulness in the everyday moments, not just the mountaintops. When I feel shaky, remind me that You have been faithful through every generation — and You won't stop now. In Jesus' name, Amen.
